strategy.name: rklb_intraday_dynamic_sma_hysteresis_grid
strategy.description: For each SMA window n, solve before every session the exact price at which the provisional current-day SMA(n), formed from the prior n-1 completed closes plus the hypothetical current price, is 1%, 2%, or 3% above or below price. Start flat. While flat, buy on an upward crossing of the selected upper buffer; while long, sell on a downward crossing of the selected lower buffer. Overnight gaps that already satisfy a live trigger execute at the regular-session Open; an intraday High/Low touch executes at the solved trigger price. At most one fill is allowed per session.
strategy.buy_rule: When flat and the prior completed close is at or below prior SMA(n)*(1+buy_pct/100), predeclare P_buy=(1+buy_pct/100)*sum(previous n-1 closes)/(n-(1+buy_pct/100)); buy if Open>=P_buy at Open, otherwise if High>=P_buy>Open at P_buy.
strategy.sell_rule: When long, predeclare P_sell=(1-sell_pct/100)*sum(previous n-1 closes)/(n-(1-sell_pct/100)); sell if Open<=P_sell at Open, otherwise if Low<=P_sell<Open at P_sell.
strategy.signal_time: Trigger eligibility and exact prices are computed before each regular session using only completed closes through the preceding session and current position state.
strategy.execution_time: Same-session regular-hours execution: gap-through fills at Open; otherwise an OHLC touch fills at the exact predeclared trigger. One adverse cost is applied per side and at most one fill occurs per session.
strategy.positioning: long-only; initially flat with 100,000 USD cash; each buy invests all cash and each sell liquidates all shares; fractional shares; no leverage or financing; idle cash earns zero

parameters.common_start_rule: All cases begin on the first RKLB session with 114 completed prior closes, so every SMA window uses the same evaluation dates; earlier canonical RKLB bars are warmup only.

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: Invest the same 100,000 USD in RKLB at the common analysis-start regular-session Open, including the configured one-sided entry cost, and hold through the 2026-08-04 Close.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse the accepted v4 strategy-card placement, navigation, visible-window axes, and performance controls. The experiment assembler adds only RKLB-specific SMA-window/threshold surfaces and overlays.

research.hypothesis: RKLB may exhibit a stable region across short-to-medium dynamic SMA windows and symmetric-scale 1%-3% hysteresis thresholds that improves drawdown-adjusted performance relative to buy-and-hold after transaction costs.
research.primary_metric: 5 bps CAGR interpreted jointly with Sharpe, maximum drawdown, exposure, order count, adjacent-window stability, all nine threshold pairs, and RKLB buy-and-hold; 0 bps is retained for cost sensitivity.
research.selection_rule: Evaluate all 51 SMA windows and all 3x3 independent buy/sell threshold pairs. Report the mechanical 5 bps CAGR maximum, and separately name a stability representative by maximizing the median 5 bps CAGR over the candidate and its adjacent SMA windows (n-2,n,n+2), breaking ties by lower neighborhood standard deviation, then Sharpe and lower drawdown. Boundary windows are ineligible for the stability representative.
research.validation_plan: For every one of the 459 cases in both cost blocks, reconcile PyBroker and an independent ledger on daily cash, shares, equity, order dates, sides, shares, and fill prices within 1e-6; run strategy tests, full tests, report-card validation, workspace audit, and browser smoke checks.
research.promotion_criteria: No promotion from this short full-history exploratory scan. A candidate may only be nominated for a separately frozen forward or walk-forward experiment if it has adequate trades, is not a boundary or isolated optimum, remains coherent at 5 bps, and all engineering gates pass.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject or redesign if any trigger uses current-bar Close before execution, OHLC ambiguity requires more than one same-day fill, ledgers diverge, the apparent winner is a no-trade or boundary artifact, costs erase the region, or results depend on one isolated window/threshold pair.
